g.title: seq
g.text: 11d One foreign project loan: approvals, signing, use of the loan and repayment

a.text: 1. National agency to ICC: Project proposal
for ICC review
2. ICC to National agency: ICC recommendation,
ED Council approval
3. National agency to DBM: Request to provide
for the project in the budget
4. DBM to DOF: Forward Obligational Authority
(project loan)
5. DOF to Monetary Board: Request for approval
in principle of the loan terms
6. Monetary Board to DOF: Approval in
principle
7. DOF to Office of the President: Request for
Special Authority, at least 10 working days
before the date needed, with: agency letter,
draft loan agreement, Monetary Board
concurrence, statement of compliance with
laws, Forward Obligational Authority
8. Office of the President to DOF: Special
Authority (or Full Powers) to negotiate and
sign
9. DOF to Dealers and lenders: Negotiation.
Loan documents cleared by the inter-agency
committee that reviews foreign loan documents
10. DOF to Dealers and lenders: Loan agreement
signed
11. Monetary Board to DOF: Final approval of
the loan terms
12. DOJ to DOF: Legal opinion on the authority
of the borrower
13. Dealers and lenders to DOF: Loan declared
effective
14. National agency to Dealers and lenders:
Withdrawal application, after the delivery is
accepted and the bill is approved. The agency
records the asset and a payable
19. Dealers and lenders to BTr: Loan proceeds
to the Treasury. BTr records cash and Loans
Payable-Foreign on the credit advice of BSP
21. BTr to Dealers and lenders: Interest and
principal on the due dates, from the Treasury
Single Account. Only the books of BTr record
them: principal reduces the loan payable,
interest is an expense
15. Dealers and lenders: Pays the supplier
directly
16. BTr to National agency: Journal entry
voucher of BTr: the lender has paid. BTr
records the subsidy to the agency and the loan
17. National agency to DBM: Copy of that
voucher and the list of suppliers paid
18. DBM to National agency: Non-Cash Availment
Authority. The agency closes the payable
against Subsidy from National Government
20. DBM to National agency: NCA under the MDS
sub-account for foreign-assisted projects

a.xlink:title: end of: Cash through the Treasury
